notes.title: Laughing Jackal's next title Flame Over now on Steam
notes.content:
[url=http://flameovergame.com/]Flame Over[/url], Laughing Jackal’s brilliant firefighting, action roguelike will be released on the 28th May. If you pre-purchase the game you’ll get a massive 40% discount off the usual price of $11.99. Flame Over looks stunning and is both rock hard and a hell of a lot of fun, so while I might be a bit biased on this one, I’d definitely recommend you check out the games Steam Store page here 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/345080

notes.title: 30.09 Elminage Gothic update
notes.content:
Yesterday we released an updated version of Elminage Gothic containing the following fixes:

Mouse input does now progresses past the party annihilated screen

Skull position for doppelganger enemies corrected

Cleric class abbreviation changed

Replaced japanese text when trying to put an ashed character on standby

Fixed text problem when finding a herb

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Elminage Gothic, 20% off!
notes.content:
Elminage Gothic is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

From the makers of the world renowned “Wizardry Empire” titles, Starfish SD brings you the latest entry in their popular series of dungeon crawlers. Elminage Gothic, previously only available in Japanese on PlayStation® Portable, now comes to PC offering a classic old school dungeon crawling experience with a dark, gothic twist!

*Offer ends September 25 at 10AM Pacific Time
